titleEn: I Thought You Meant Stay Away

pages.text: A school of fish came into the stream, shining silver. Mumu saw them and opened their eyes wide.
"I'll show Taro!" But calling loudly would scare the fish away. Mumu only waved a hand.
Bugs kept landing on Mumu's face. Buzz, buzz. Mumu swung their arms around.
Far away, Taro saw Mumu waving wildly. It looked like a signal to go away.
Taro stopped short. "Do they mean don't come?" He sat down right there.
Mumu kept waving, because the bugs would not leave. Harder and harder.
Taro backed farther away. Mumu waved harder. The gap between them kept growing.
The bugs flew all the way to Taro. Buzz, buzz. He swung his arms, too. "Oh, bugs!"
Taro ran over, waving his arms. Mumu waved, too. Their arms moved just alike.
They looked into the stream. Not one fish remained. The shadows of their arms had scared them all away.
